author: JoeVC
body:
Hey guys, so i know it is mid tournament and most teams probably arent looking for players but i will make this anyway.

So i am looking for a team where i can develop my skills and have fun playing wether that be long or short term.

PvP KD - 0.98
Position - Midline/Support(DTM and CTW) Anchor (CTH)
Skype - joeslap22
Timezone - GMT
Previous Teams - Qrysis
I prefer a sword to a bow, but im working on using both, i mainly play offensive(DTM) however i can play defensive if needs be. Hit me up on skype or TS if you want to ask anything else.
